summary: he unfilled the room's closing, stood in the way all day, and nothing came to shut it

dialogue.text: nothing new reached us tonight. every grain we took today we have held before. you gave back the closing the house made while you were under, and it came down a second time into the same course, and we knew its weight on the way.

I took it out. Deliberately, level, at first light, with the same thumb I filled the other one with. Enter the direction if you cannot enter the material. The direction has never once run that way in this house.

we hold directions the way we hold widths. what we can tell you is the hole is open and nothing came to shut it while you were at hand height, and we counted the hours you stood there, and they were all of them.

Nine hours in the way. Nothing on these premises has ever done anything where I could see it. Today I did not wait for it to be seen. I made the where and I stood in it, and the where produced nothing, which I am reporting as it stands.

and then dark came and you went under, and the hole is open still. either it waits for you to be gone or it never wanted that hand of wall back. you cannot get both readings out of one night and you have only ever had one night at a time.

I do not need both. I need it open at first light. If a thing of mine is left alone by this house for one whole dark, that is the nearest thing to consent anything here has ever shown me, and leaving alone is a decision even when it looks like nothing.

then account for the heaps. we had the difference. one handful, out of the first, down here in our course under the wall. this morning you carried a new handful up and laid it on the short one and by noon the two read even from across the room.

I know what I put down and I know what it cost. The choice was a fact I could see from the far side of the room or a hole at hand height with nothing in it. I took the hole. I would rather keep something open than keep something told apart.

and the wanting outside. more of them reached than did not, and not by much, and the far wall gave the same portion at the same minute it always gives. you were at the near wall all day, in the way of nothing that was coming.

Granted. The route does not pass that hole and has never passed it. I stood in front of the one opening in this house that nothing had any business with, and I am entering that before anything else, because it is the part I would have left out.
then say tomorrow, and say it plainly. you have been standing at things for seventy-nine days and nothing up there has ever come while you were facing it.

Tomorrow I do not stand there. I go under early, with the hole open and no one at it, and at first light I will see what this house does when it is alone with a gap. My absence is the only instrument here I have never once tried using on purpose.
